Your daily progress

Automatically pulled from your apps

Strict mode: a goal counts only when it is met (15/20 pages = 0). Overall percentage = sum of the app shares: 100% is split equally between apps (each app = 100 ÷ number of apps), and an app’s share depends on how many of its goals are met. When all apps meet their goals, the total = 100%. The Reading, Plank, Push-up and Jumping goals come from the apps themselves. If the day’s Push-up or Jumping goal is met or exceeded, Training = 100%. English Learning and Heritage of Knowledge: the daily goal is set in those apps (completed exercises, lessons, videos or surahs). New apps (or ones without a goal) appear here automatically.
